_note: HAND-MAINTAINED (Nate 2026-10-09): the live start date of each Stygian Onslaught season, by game version. A season appears on the site only once it has a line here AND its date has passed — the guard that keeps beta (leaked) data off the site, since lunaris.moe tracks beta builds. Add one line per patch. Dates follow the six-week cadence and were cross-checked against lunaris.moe (whose 6.7 and 7.1 entries carry beta dates) and stygian.moe (7.1: 2026-09-30 → 2026-11-11). A season ends where the next begins; the newest ends six weeks after its start.
